# Set47 retained candidate bout core contract — review draft

This is an external design draft only. No Set47 runtime or expected output is authorized until root freezes the reviewed core/helper contracts. Set46 source and reference bytes stay unchanged during this review. The scope is one explicitly selected bout already booked by the existing two-fixture C1 card, using unchanged `fighterbout` v1. Companion helper design owns root v7, closed wire frames, native/local playback and UI.

## 1. Fixed behavior and boundaries

Select an existing full BoutID from one retained `gymcard.Record.Plan.Bouts`; the request supplies only the canonical Saturday and BoutID under the original participant View. It cannot supply fighters, seed, manifests, birth, conditions, bonuses, results or an authorization Boolean. Both current held fixture sessions may run or read this non-spending candidate action. Revoked, expired, foreign and mining-token sessions do not gain that capability.

The fight is `slug-fighter-bout-candidate-v1`, version1, `standard`, explicit seed, three rounds. Its common AsOfMS is exactly the original event CutoffMS, its seed exactly the booked Bout.Seed, and corners exactly the booked ascending full ProspectIDs. Derive each complete canonical manifest from the retained Assignment.WorkHash and original descriptor; require its manifest digest and physical class to match. BornAtMS is the original Assignment birth, ProXP=0 and TrainingSkill=0. Reproject condition v1 at that cutoff with XP0 and compare every field to the saved Member.ConditionAtCutoff before simulation. Do not substitute current time, roster, retirement, gym attribution or ownership. A later retired fighter can still have this originally eligible bout. Existing D65, D75, engine equations, versions, random streams, condition and manifest bytes do not change.

The saved artifact is neither a professional nor exhibition record, award, title, league publication or official result certificate. C1's `candidate_zero_record_no_results_authority` assumption remains unchanged. Unmatched entrants have no bout, run or loss. A seed checkpoint is not result finality. No results signing, transaction, node RPC, mining, professional W/L/D, XP/training, matchmaking, transfer or general league policy enters this set. No automatic Run on login, navigation, source observation or polling.

A saved result is immutable. Existing same-BoutID Run is an early authorized replay; no engine call, seed replacement, reroll or creation-time reset. A new relevant retained source conflict blocks an unsaved result. A saved result survives that conflict with a separate current source overlay. Historical seed finality with an offline node or shallower above-target chain remains usable absent a relevant conflict, preserving Set45/46 meanings; no new chain-freshness claim is made.

## 2. Additive concrete source seam in gymcard

No old DTO, public method, journal schema or engine API changes. New files in gymcard expose these exact owned DTOs, with fields in the listed canonical order and snake_case tags. Existing nested types retain their frozen fields and validators.

- `BoutCorner`: `owner gymevent.AssignmentOwner; member gymevent.Member`.
- `BoutSource`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; card_record_digest string; card_source_digest string; card_created_at_ms int64; event gymevent.Event; snapshot_digest string; seed_event_key string; target_height uint32; target_hash string; finalized_at_ms int64; bout Bout; corners []BoutCorner`.
- `BoutState`: `version uint32=1; card_id string; event gymevent.Event; card_exists bool; card_record_digest string; card_source_digest string; card_created_at_ms int64; finalized_at_ms int64; conflict_count uint32; conflict_overflow bool; incident_at_ms int64; escalation_due bool; chain_observed_at_ms int64; target_descendants uint32; current_finality bool; node_state string; observed_at_ms int64; usable bool`.
- `BoutRef`: `bout Bout; source_digest string`.
- `BoutView`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; pin Pin; created_at_ms int64; participant_account_id string; participant_gym_id string; observed_at_ms int64; state BoutState; bouts []BoutRef`.

BoutSource is a compact immutable projection of one fully validated retained card. It does not repeat the complete source receipt, declaration, anchor or other bouts. CardRecordDigest commits that omitted evidence; this projection is not a portable proof of admission, first-anchor absence or ownership. StoreID/Pin are the card authority. CardSourceDigest is the existing card Record.SourceDigest, whereas new `BoutSourceDigest` below hashes this selected projection. They are different typed commitments, never interchangeable.

Corners has exactly two rows, A then B, sorted by full Assignment.ProspectID and equal to Bout.CornerA/B. Each is exactly one original participant Owner+Member, with distinct pinned gyms/account identities, ownership basis `candidate_assignment`, eligibility `eligible`, nonretired condition at cutoff, and original roster slot/placement. Both classes equal Bout.Class. The original card proves C1 eligibility/band/zero-record basis; this seam neither repairs invalid sources nor independently rematches. All full IDs across the retained card remain unique. Copy ManifestDigest and PortraitDigest in each Assignment unchanged; neither source projection nor core poll renders SVG.

From the source fields derive the existing Set46 CardID, card InputID, Plan.seed, BoutID and Bout.Seed using its frozen recipes (same card RulesID and class index). No copied current status, signature, source observation time or result creation time enters the engine seed. `card_created_at_ms >= finalized_at_ms >= event.cutoff_ms`; existing source validation also supplies stronger capture/target chronology before projection. The compact projection cannot check omitted ancestry/signature preimages and must not claim it does. TargetHeight is1..2147483647 and hashes are lowercase64-hex. Source pure validation checks the two retained assignments/condition/manifests and all available identities and bounds, but does not grant provenance.

BoutState is a compact projection of a fresh authorized card Status, not an independent authority. It copies the exact existing event and current seed overlay meanings. Its local ObservedAtMS is the new card/source observation, distinct from ChainObservedAtMS. Positive last-chain timestamps and node_state describe the last retained observation, not a new RPC. Absent card: card_exists=false; card record/source digests empty; card_created_at_ms=0; usable=false; seed finality/conflict/deadline facts may nevertheless exist. Existing card: both digests present, `finalized_at_ms <= card_created_at_ms <= observed_at_ms`; state usable=true implies historical finality and no conflict/overflow. A standalone state cannot prove equality with an omitted saved transcript's source digest. The exact node_state enum is `unobserved|online|offline|unavailable`. ConflictCount is0..8; overflow requires count8. FinalizedAtMS, IncidentAtMS and ChainObservedAtMS are0 or positive timestamps<=ObservedAtMS; TargetDescendants is0..2147483647. EscalationDue equals `observed_at_ms >= event.incident_deadline_ms && (finalized_at_ms == 0 || conflict_count > 0 || conflict_overflow)`. Nonzero IncidentAtMS is the retained first incident observation, not the deadline: it is>=Event.IncidentDeadlineMS and<=ObservedAtMS and remains immutable even if later valid finality makes EscalationDue=false. It does not require current escalation to remain due. ChainObservedAtMS=0 requires descendants0/current_finality=false; current_finality=true requires positive historical finality/chain observation, descendants>=60 and no conflict/overflow. Local observation does not turn last NodeState into a live connectivity claim. No scan-height fields are added, so this projection has no -1 sentinel.

BoutView always has one State for the requested date. Its Bouts is nonnull, empty only when card is absent or its completed plan has no bouts, otherwise all original booked refs in canonical class order, max5. Each Ref.SourceDigest hashes its compact immutable BoutSource. State and View observed timestamps are equal; View.StoreID=ID(View.Pin); CreatedAtMS is the immutable card-store creation, not card-row time. Caller identity is exactly the currently authorized pinned participant. Empty/unbooked results are not synthesized from incomplete card source.

Exact APIs (standard owned return values):

```go
func BoutSourceDigest(expected Pin, value BoutSource) (string, error)
func (s *Store) WithBoutView(ctx context.Context, seeds *gymseed.Store, events *gymevent.Store, entries *gymentry.Store, session gymstable.Session, saturday string, commit func(BoutView, func() error) error) error
func (s *Store) WithBoutSource(ctx context.Context, seeds *gymseed.Store, events *gymevent.Store, entries *gymentry.Store, session gymstable.Session, saturday, boutID string, prepare func(BoutSource) (func(BoutView, func() error) error, error)) error
```

For each new X expose `ValidateX(expected Pin,value X)(X,error)`, `MarshalX(expected Pin,value X)([]byte,error)` and `ParseX(expected Pin,raw []byte)(X,error)`. These are bounded semantic source DTO functions, not imports or cached poll calls. Nil context/handles/callbacks, malformed date or BoutID refuse before effects.

WithBoutView takes the card gate and authorizes the original View through concrete seed→event→entry→stable/account dependencies. Read and validate the retained card and derive compact source/ref metadata outside the final account lease. Preserve the actual pre47 chain: gymcard.record validates Record, which calls gymseed.ValidateCardSource, gymevent.ValidateSnapshotReceipt (canonical manifest/condition projection), and derivePlanValidated (names); the concrete seed final-view path also validates its own retained source evidence. This bounded existing source semantic audit is allowed once per explicit operation per existing dependency, not once per booked ref. Project/copy all<=5 BoutSources from the already validated card and privately hash their trusted canonical shape; do not call public ValidateBoutSource/BoutSourceDigest again per ref. No existing source validation is bypassed or weakened. Invoke the original final source View, verify immutable card/source creation and digests, persist necessary source/card monotonic clock and existing deadline observations, then invoke the consumer callback under the existing final lease. Supply a nonnil current recheck; no source write follows the foreign callback in that invocation. Missing card returns an authentic absent State and empty refs, without allocating a card. It performs no engine, source proof, RPC, signing, SVG or Build.

WithBoutSource uses the same gate and authorization; requires retained card, selected booked BoutID and usable source. Missing card/incomplete seed is card_source_incomplete, unbooked valid BoutID card_not_found, relevant conflict card_source_conflict. Copy and validate selected BoutSource, invoke prepare outside all account leases/store mutexes while holding only the card resource gate. Final View checks that the selected Ref.SourceDigest and card row/source identity remain exact and usable, then supplies the guarded short commit. Original session never changes during prepare. A separately authorized subsequent invocation may observe state; no automatic Build or simulated fallback exists. A consumer sync followed by outer cancellation/revocation is unknown even if lower source errors otherwise appear cancelled.

## 3. gymbout DTOs and unchanged engine composition

Package name `gymbout`; version1. All new fields are required; no generic JSON/map payloads. All arrays nonnull and ordered. ASCII strings, lowercase64-hex IDs/digests, positive times<=8640000000000000 except explicitly absent0; counters<=9007199254740991. Full old engine field types and canonical equations remain unchanged.

- `Pin`: `version uint32=1; source_store_id string; source_pin gymcard.Pin; rules_id string`.
- `Info`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; pin Pin; source_created_at_ms int64; created_at_ms int64; bout_count uint32`.
- `Record`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; bout_id string; source gymcard.BoutSource; source_digest string; input fighterbout.Input; input_id string; result fighterbout.Result; result_digest string; created_at_ms int64`.
- `SavedBout`: `bout gymcard.Bout; source_digest string; exists bool; record_digest string; created_at_ms int64; input_id string; result_digest string; winner string; method string; end_round uint32; end_tick uint32; usable bool`.
- `Status`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; observed_at_ms int64; source gymcard.BoutState; saved SavedBout`.
- `CardStatus`: `version uint32=1; store_id string; card_id string; observed_at_ms int64; source gymcard.BoutState; bouts []SavedBout`.
- `RunResult`: `version uint32=1; record Record; status Status; replayed bool`.
- `ReadResult`: `version uint32=1; record Record; status Status`.

SavedBout exists=false represents an actually booked but not yet saved bout. Its SourceDigest and Bout are known from the concrete card. RecordDigest, InputID, ResultDigest, Winner and Method are empty; CreatedAtMS, EndRound and EndTick are0; usable=false. Existing row has all three digests, positive creation time<=outer observation and >=both bout-store creation and source card creation/finality; winner empty only for the engine's draw methods. Its method/end fields exactly equal its retained Result. Usable means saved row exists, immutable source matches current concrete selected Ref, and the current card source is usable. It does not mean official/final professional result or current network freshness. Pure standalone Status only enforces implications knowable from its available fields; full Read/Run results enforce exact Record/status/digest/input/result/summary equivalence. Specifically saved.source_digest equals Record.SourceDigest, current card-record/source digests equal Record.Source.CardRecordDigest/CardSourceDigest, and the source event/card ID/first finality and booked Bout are identical. Full result usable equals source.usable after these equalities; a standalone usable=false may not be rejected merely because its available source looks healthy. SavedBout alone cannot derive a seed or InputID without its absent source; it validates local closed fields and present/absent summary relationships only.

CardStatus returns max5 rows in the original card's class order, with one common source overlay/time. Every booked bout appears, saved or not; no unmatched fighter is converted into a row. Existing Card UI retains unmatched details independently. An absent or legitimately empty card has zero rows, distinguishable through Source.CardExists. No global bout history/page API is added: existing CardHistory supplies historical dates. No response includes five transcripts.

Construct Input from the two compact source corners as described in §1, then call unchanged `fighterbout.NewInput(cutoff, Bout.Seed, a, b)` and require its sorted corners remain exactly the booked A/B. Compare both `fightercondition.Project(1, canonicalDNA, BornAtMS, cutoff, 0)` snapshots to saved conditions. The full Input and single complete Result appear once each in Record. No duplicated Manifest or conditions are added to every tick. Source retains two original Member conditions and assignments for evidence and portrait binding.

## 4. Canonical identities, codecs and explicit cost

H=SHA256, ID=raw32 from lowercase hex, LE32=unsigned little endian, LP=LE32 byte length followed by bytes, J=canonical JSON (listed fixed field order, no whitespace or LF), NUL=actual00. Engine commitments retain their existing domains and lack an added LP.

Rules is exactly the ordered object:
`{"version":1,"scope":"two_fixture_booked_candidate_bout","record_basis":"candidate_zero_record_no_results_authority","card_rules_id":<gymcard.RulesID>,"engine_version":1,"engine_id":"slug-fighter-bout-candidate-v1","mode":"standard","seed_kind":"explicit","rounds":3,"as_of":"event_cutoff","seed":"booked_bout_seed","pro_xp":0,"training_skill":0,"new_run_requires_usable_card":true,"saved_replay_immutable":true}`.

- RulesID=H(`SLUG candidate bout rules\0v1\0` || LP(J(Rules))).
- StoreID=H(`SLUG candidate bout store\0v1\0` || LP(J(Pin))). CandidatePin binds exact compiled card Pin/ID and RulesID; no random handle.
- BoutSourceDigest=H(`SLUG candidate booked bout source\0v1\0` || LP(J(gymcard.BoutSource))).
- InputID remains H(`SLUG fighter bout input\0v1\0` || J(Input)).
- ResultDigest remains H(`SLUG fighter bout result\0v1\0` || J(Result)).
- RecordDigest=H(`SLUG candidate bout record\0v1\0` || LP(J(Record))).

The existing booked BoutID, scoped by the gymbout StoreID, is the stable query/idempotency key. A new run ID, operation nonce, session/generation, later clock or creation time never selects a new result. No new bout seed or PRNG is introduced.

For Pin expose ValidatePin/MarshalPin/ParsePin. For Info, SavedBout, Status and CardStatus expose `ValidateX(expected Pin,value X)(X,error)`, `MarshalX(expected Pin,value X)([]byte,error)`, `ParseX(expected Pin,raw []byte)(X,error)`. Expose pure `DeriveInput(expected Pin,source gymcard.BoutSource)(fighterbout.Input,error)` for independent composition checks; it grants no source authority.

For engine-containing Record, RunResult and ReadResult use explicit context-bearing full validators/codecs:
`ValidateX(ctx context.Context,expected Pin,value X)(X,error)`, `MarshalX(ctx context.Context,expected Pin,value X)([]byte,error)`, `ParseX(ctx context.Context,expected Pin,raw []byte)(X,error)`. These APIs fully rederive the input and validate the complete deterministic result using unchanged engine validation. `RecordDigest(ctx,Pin,Record)(string,error)` likewise denotes full validation and is never a poll/read path. Their cost is deliberate. Native/helper retained-result parsing instead uses private bounded structural/canonical checks; no public structural-acceptance function is an authority importer.

New Run may call Simulate once and rely on that owned engine return after bounded accounting/shape/canonical preflight; it must not call a chain of public Validate/Marshal/Digest APIs that silently re-simulates repeatedly. Its private canonical digest helper is only for the already validated/engine-produced owned value. Full Open audit calls one complete ValidateResult per row, not one call per digest/codec. No simulation or full-result public validator is permitted in Store.Read, Status, CardStatus, replayed Run, Info, Snapshot or Job. Static dependency/call-count regressions enforce this separation.

Strict parsers bound raw bytes, container depth<=16, field names<=64, decoded duplicate/unknown/missing keys, typed arrays and string lengths before materialization. Accept permitted JSON whitespace/object-key order, then canonical re-encode; storage requires exact canonical bytes. Arrays must already have semantic order; no sorting to repair malformed inputs. No floats, exponents, booleans-as-numbers, negative zero, non-ASCII or null arrays. Nullable fields only inherit `Result.rounds[*].recovery`; no new nullable DTO fields. New grammar preserves only these existing signed values at exact typed paths: `Input.{a,b}.manifest.portrait.shoulder_jitter` in -6..6 and `Result.initial[0..1].form_q` in -100000..100000 (under Record and Run/Read wrappers). All other encoded integers are nonnegative and obey existing engine/manifest/source bounds. JitterQ is the positive engine KO-threshold factor, not a signed field. No suffix-wide negative allowance.

Proposed caps to be checked by independent formula before freeze: Pin24KiB; Info/marker/metadata28KiB; BoutSource16KiB; BoutState4KiB; BoutView32KiB; composition Input16KiB (existing engine public max32KiB remains unchanged); Result192KiB unchanged; Record232KiB; SavedBout2KiB; Status8KiB; CardStatus16KiB; RunResult/ReadResult244KiB; helper frame256KiB including LF. These limits do not change old engine or card validators. The smaller composition Input cap must be proven sufficient for every canonical supported manifest before freeze, rather than rejecting a valid generated fighter later. Working memory holds one full transcript at a time; shared UI/helper caches are separately charged by helper contract.

## 5. Store API, constructors and bounded audit

```go
func CandidatePin(source gymcard.Pin) (Pin,error)
func ID(Pin) (string,error)
func RulesID() string
func DeriveInput(Pin,gymcard.BoutSource) (fighterbout.Input,error)
func RecordDigest(context.Context,Pin,Record) (string,error)
func Create(context.Context,string,Pin,*gymcard.Store) (*Store,error)
func Open(context.Context,string,Pin,*gymcard.Store) (*Store,error)
func ResumePrepared(context.Context,string,Pin,*gymcard.Store) (*Store,error)
func (s *Store) Close() error
func (s *Store) Info(context.Context) (Info,error)
func (s *Store) Run(ctx context.Context,cards *gymcard.Store,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday,boutID string) (RunResult,error)
func (s *Store) Read(ctx context.Context,cards *gymcard.Store,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday,boutID string) (ReadResult,error)
func (s *Store) Status(ctx context.Context,cards *gymcard.Store,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday,boutID string) (Status,error)
func (s *Store) CardStatus(ctx context.Context,cards *gymcard.Store,seeds *gymseed.Store,events *gymevent.Store,entries *gymentry.Store,session gymstable.Session,saturday string) (CardStatus,error)
```

Constructors borrow only the concrete card store's bounded Info for full Pin/ID/immutable source CreatedAtMS binding. The gymbout object retains no source pointer. Creation time is actual authority time after durable initialization intent, >=source-store creation; there is no new created-before-noon rule. Reject cheap PoW before path effects. Parent owns the shared journal independently of the current child; helper binds it after source setup. Normal constructors use private time.Now. Only `slugtestclock` files add CreateForTestClock/OpenForTestClock/ResumePreparedForTestClock with a final `clock func() time.Time`, validating nonnil scoped clock and the existing fixture/normal profile; no normal config/flag/environment or global setter.

MaxSavedBouts=256 total immutable rows, distinct from card's256-event capacity and max5 bouts per card. This is candidate resource capacity, not a league limit. Never evict, overwrite or recycle a saved result to admit another. Existing replay/read works at capacity; new Run refuses before simulation where possible. Canonical retained row bytes<=256*232KiB, plus metadata/marker; total canonical payload budget64MiB. Physical LevelDB logs/metadata are not falsely claimed to obey that byte bound. Open bounds each raw key/value before decode, rejects unknown/extra/counterfeit rows and checks actual count<=256; context checked between every row and by the engine during simulation. Rows sharing CardID must share the exact immutable card/event/source/target/snapshot/finality commitments and card creation time, have distinct booked classes/BoutIDs and number<=5. The same CardRecordDigest cannot assert contradictory source projections. These cross-row checks detect internally impossible journals; fresh disclosure still requires the concrete source equality.

Open performs the full input/source structural and deterministic-engine audit once per retained row, serially, outside account/source leases. This is not proof of portable admission: subsequent disclosures still authenticate the concrete selected card binding. Only after every row passes does it publish the Store. It retains a private bounded index of `(BoutID,CardID,Saturday,RecordDigest,SavedBout immutable summary)` derived from that successful audit; no transcript/manifest/source payload cache or authoritative persistent index. Cap the canonical index representation384KiB. A new insert precomputes its replacement index outside final lease and publishes it only after the synced row succeeds. Poisoned/uncertain state discards authority until reopen.

Read/status/replay load the selected DB row bytes (at most one for Read/Status, at most5 for CardStatus), bound and hash them against the Open/insert-audited exact canonical RecordDigest. Missing or changed bytes fail corrupt. Status/CardStatus can then copy only the audited immutable summary, without decoding the transcript; Read/replay performs bounded structural decode/canonical equality and returns an owned result. Never return a full cached row as authority. No re-simulation or Input/condition/name/portrait regeneration occurs for these local transcript payload paths. This is not an absolute ban on the separate explicit source read: the once-per-operation existing card/seed source semantic audit in §2 may regenerate its bounded source manifests/conditions/names outside the final account lease. Cached Snapshot/Job do no source work at all. Preserve this precise distinction; do not add a new Card audit cache or weaken its validator to make a broader performance claim. Source payload identity is freshly compared before disclosure; corrupted rows are never silently re-audited/repaired in a poll.

The potentially heavier full Open audit has a separate measured acceptance bound and cancellable startup path; do not label it a250ms metadata operation. At capacity demonstrate completion under the helper's declared startup deadline, with actual timings and peak retained-row count. A250ms original-View CardStatus over all five saved rows, with the worst retained ten-entrant source card and its unchanged full source semantic audit, must remain feasible when uncontended; contention returns busy honestly. No synthetic fixture generator is exposed in production to satisfy that test.

## 6. Run, replay, observation and lock order

Take gymbout resource gate, validate date/ID and original View, then check the deterministic saved row before any simulation. Existing row is verified against the audited index and exact selected card/source binding; final authorized WithBoutView supplies fresh overlay and local observation. Return exact immutable Record bytes/first CreatedAtMS with replayed=true, even if relevant conflict now makes usable=false. Do not call WithBoutSource's new-run health requirement for replay. A same-Pin source whose immutable creation/card-record/selected-source digest is missing or changed returns bout_source_changed without stale payload or overwrite.

For a new Run, WithBoutSource prepares one owned source projection; check journal capacity, derive/validate Input and saved cutoff equality, simulate the unchanged engine with the original cancellable task context, validate bounded complete result/accounting, compute canonical InputID/ResultDigest/SourceDigest and record-size envelope outside final account lease. Precompute next index and worst-case timestamp byte budget. No intermediate pending result is persisted and no partial transcript becomes a draw. Source gates may serialize this bounded computation, but no mutex or original account lease spans it.

Final source callback verifies original session, exact source-store creation, same CardRecordDigest/BoutSourceDigest and still-usable card. Then under gymbout mutex verify lifetime/poison/capacity/row absence, recheck cancellation and sample actual monotonic time>=all retained source observations, card/result-store creation and source card creation/finality. Cutoff Input.AsOfMS is unchanged. Only bounded checks, owned copies, trusted fixed-order serialization/hash and one synchronous row+metadata batch occur in final lease; no full semantic validator, manifest, condition, engine, signature, portrait or source public call. Set CreatedAtMS to this actual time. Write attempted/success flags distinguish definite prewrite refusal from possible/confirmed sync. Any outer lease/context failure after possible insertion is outcome_unknown; poison on uncertain local sync and recover by same date/BoutID query after reopen. A final callback cannot reenter source/account/gymbout public methods.

Order: bout gate→card gate→seed gate→event gate→entry gate→stable resource gate as needed→original account lease; final existing source mutex order→card mutex→bout mutex. Do not acquire an account lease then call a public source method. Within each guarded callback all source observations happen before foreign sync, none after. Parent cancels/joins active child lane before closing shared bout→card→seed→event journals. Start/Stop can replace entry/stable/source handles; borrow the exact current set per tracked operation, never retain stale handles in gymbout. Close cancels lifetime and joins the gate; no uncancellable pre-gate mutex or orphan simulation goroutine.

Read, Status and CardStatus may sync monotonic local/source clocks and existing seed incident observations under original View. They never Run, simulate, publish, sign, mine or manufacture missing records. Post-observation write uncertainty remains outcome_unknown but means observation uncertainty, not a saved fight or transaction. Local authority time rollback or now below a trusted lower bound fails bout_clock. Source observation/finality freshness remains separate from actual result creation and fixed cutoff condition.

Canonical absent/edge returns: CardStatus for missing card gives authentic Source.CardExists=false and empty rows without allocation; completed empty card gives true and empty rows. Status for a retained booked but unsaved bout succeeds with Exists=false. A valid unknown/unbooked BoutID returns bout_not_found. Read of an unsaved booked bout returns bout_not_found. New Run lacking retained complete card is bout_source_incomplete; relevant conflict is bout_source_conflict. Invalid date/out-of-supported-calendar is bout_calendar; malformed ID is invalid_request. A read never executes absent old intent. Dates remain queryable across rollover. No operation timestamps are reset by replay.

## 7. Durable layout and recovery

Owned directory e.g. parent `bouts`, with only `SLUG-CANDIDATE-BOUTS.json` and `db`. Marker canonical fields: `application="SLUG candidate bouts",version=1,store_id,pin`, followed by one LF. LevelDB keys: `meta`; optional `init` only for recognized initialization; byte `r` + raw BoutID32. Metadata: `version,store_id,pin,source_created_at_ms,created_at_ms,clock_ms,bout_count`. Init: `version,store_id,pin,source_created_at_ms`. No caller record import, extra keys, row overwrite/deletion, WAL repair or pruning.

Use the reviewed existing owned-directory/init pattern, not a new generic framework. Real protected paths, no symlink/unknown directory adoption. Create permits absent or real empty directory, syncs exact marker/init before actual CreatedAtMS sample, then syncs complete metadata and deletes init atomically. ResumePrepared alone invokes the same recognized initialization for absent/real-empty owned paths, or completes exact marker-only/recognized init-only state, or reopens an already initialized empty journal preserving original times; initialized nonempty is not prepared recovery. Open/ready refuses missing/partial storage and never recreates it. Parent v7 transition/writer preservation is helper contract; every ready dependency is validated before upgrade. Parent SourceCreatedAtMS must remain the actual retained card-store time across restart. Full Open checks every row, key, Pin, identity, count, chronology, input, source recipe and transcript; returns no usable object on partial audit/cancellation.

Public errors: invalid_request, unauthorized, forbidden, stale_view, busy, outcome_unknown; bout_unavailable, bout_corrupt, bout_capacity, bout_clock, bout_calendar, bout_not_found, bout_source_incomplete, bout_source_conflict, bout_source_changed, bout_cancelled. Internal ErrClosed=`bout store closed`, ErrPoisoned=`bout write uncertain; reopen required`, ErrProfile=`bout requires production PoW`. Source errors map by meaning without changing old strings. Pure malformed composition/DTO/result is ErrInvalid; impossible retained bytes/source facts are ErrCorrupt; genuine engine arithmetic/stream failure is unavailable, never a stored draw. Authority failure after possible write cannot hide uncertainty. No new gymaccount capability or session schema is needed: original View remains the only account authority.

## 8. Acceptance and remaining freeze work

Before freeze: independent field-order/nesting/max-shape calculation proves all proposed caps including generated Input16KiB; final helper/native tuple/frame/cache types and parent v7 are reviewed; precise source callback/API review is complete. These are finite engineering checks, not new product choices. No new engine or expected-output execution before the joint freeze/reference procedure.

Independent Python composition uses frozen Set46 source/card formulas and frozen Set42 engine, never Go outputs as expected. Freeze exact canonical Source/Input/InputID/full Result/ResultDigest/Record identity cases before Go comparison. Include all booked classes available in modeled complete cards, at least one actual genuine retained-card bout, both fixture attribution orders, late-run versus cutoff, later retirement, zero bonuses, source field/seed/bout/condition drift, and conflict overlays with unchanged historical result. Reuse existing engine rare-method/primitive corpus rather than claiming new compound source fixtures realize all rare finishes.

Tests cover original held versus revoked/expired/foreign/mining authorization; no extra account or node authority; exact conflict/source change before and after simulation/final lease; concurrent same-BoutID one-row commit; same-canonical replay at capacity; cancellation throughout engine and after sync; full Open audit and context cancellation; actual SIGKILL at marker/init/initialized/before-result-sync/after-result-sync, with retained first creation; source closure/swap and ready-missing/partial refusal. Add dependency/call-count tests proving reads/status/polls/replay never simulate and final account callbacks never derive condition/manifest/engine output. Rehash an altered stored transcript with otherwise valid shape to prove full Open engine audit refuses it; mutate an already-open raw row to prove the index digest fence refuses disclosure.

At256 saved rows measure serial full Open separately, and prove one selected transcript plus all-five CardStatus within the unchanged metadata bound when uncontended; no all-row simulation/validation during metadata. Parent install kill tests remain separate from populated transcript replay. The actual retained Set46 card journal already has a latched target conflict. Preserve it as a negative; never clear, roll back or relabel that history to manufacture a positive Run. Root chose a later Saturday on an owned cold copy of the genuine Set46 journals and chain: preserve every original assignment/birth and old conflict, then perform a fresh legitimate entry, cutoff snapshot, explicit publication, fixed target with60 descendants/finality, and a new card for the later event. Reuse existing mature public-fixture funding only if it remains valid; no hidden mint/fund shortcut. Use only the scoped test clock, with no normal release clock override. Execution waits for the frozen Set47 contract. Explicit final-binary run/reopen then exports public Input/Result for independent complete arithmetic verification. Scoped-clock closed-event evidence is labelled separately from real-clock packaged open/pending behavior. Keep old preview/Card/Seed/Entry wire routes, engine/reference bytes and UI controls unchanged. No D74/visual/chooser/screen-reader acceptance is implied by DOM or process tests.
